Title: To verify Tax Authority Level options appear on Smart AP invoice details when Tax Type is Tax Authority Levels
Steps:
1. Login with AP create rights.
2. In CAS, set Tax Type = Tax Authority Levels and Show Tax Level Fields = Show 4 Fields; Save.
3. Open Smart AP > Create New Invoice > Create From Scratch for the same company.
4. Observe invoice header / tax section where invoice details are managed.
Test Data: Company 931; Tax Type = Tax Authority Levels; Show Tax Level Fields = Show 4 Fields
Expected Outcome: Tax Authority Level (Tax Level ID) options are displayed on the Smart AP invoice create/edit screen where invoice details are managed.

Title: To verify Tax Level field count on Smart AP follows CAS Show Tax Level Fields = Off
Steps:
1. In CAS Tax section, set Show Tax Level Fields = Off; Save.
2. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch.
3. Check Tax Level 1-4 ID fields.
Expected Outcome: Tax Level 1-4 ID fields are not visible on Smart AP.

Title: To verify only Tax Level 1 is visible when Show Tax Level Fields = Show 1 Field
Steps:
1. Set Show Tax Level Fields = Show 1 Field; Save.
2. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch.
3. Check Tax Level fields.
Expected Outcome: Only Tax Level 1 ID is visible; Tax Level 2-4 are hidden.

Title: To verify Tax Level 1-2 are visible when Show Tax Level Fields = Show 2 Fields
Steps:
1. Set Show Tax Level Fields = Show 2 Fields; Save.
2. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch.
Expected Outcome: Tax Level 1 and 2 IDs are visible; Tax Level 3 and 4 are hidden.

Title: To verify Tax Level 1-3 are visible when Show Tax Level Fields = Show 3 Fields
Steps:
1. Set Show Tax Level Fields = Show 3 Fields; Save.
2. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch.
Expected Outcome: Tax Level 1-3 IDs are visible; Tax Level 4 is hidden.

Title: To verify Tax Level 1-4 are visible and editable when Show Tax Level Fields = Show 4 Fields
Steps:
1. Set Show Tax Level Fields = Show 4 Fields; Save.
2. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch.
3. Confirm each Tax Level ID field is visible and can be updated via lookup/input.
Expected Outcome: All four Tax Level ID fields are clearly visible and editable/updatable on Smart AP.

Title: To verify user can set Tax Authority Level flags at invoice header level on Smart AP
Steps:
1. Ensure Show 4 Fields is saved in CAS.
2. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch.
3. Select valid Tax Level 1 ID (and Level 2 if shown) on the invoice header/tax section.
4. Observe selected values remain on the form.
Test Data: Valid Tax Level IDs configured in CAS
Expected Outcome: Selected Tax Authority Level values are set and retained at invoice header level before save.

Title: To verify user can set Tax Authority Level flags at invoice/line level on Smart AP
Steps:
1. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch with Show 4 Fields.
2. Add invoice line(s).
3. Set Tax Authority Level on invoice/line tax fields where available.
4. Confirm values are accepted on the form.
Test Data: Show 4 Fields; valid Tax Level ID
Expected Outcome: Tax Authority Level can be set at invoice/line level and values remain on the form.

Title: To verify tax amount populates from tax percentage x subtotal
Steps:
1. Ensure Param 932 is ON (if required for tax population).
2. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch.
3. Select Tax Level with tax percentage = 10%.
4. Enter line/subtotal amount = 1000.00.
5. Observe calculated tax.

Title: To verify tax amount for fractional subtotal and percentage
Steps:
1. Select Tax Level with tax percentage = 7.5%.
2. Enter subtotal = 250.50.
3. Observe calculated tax.
Expected Outcome: Tax amount = 18.7875 rounded per product rounding rule (expected display matches system rounding for 250.50 x 7.5%).

Title: To verify Header Tax Amount is disabled and not manually editable
Steps:
1. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch with tax levels visible.
2. Locate Header Tax Amount field.
3. Attempt to type/edit the value.
Test Data: Show 4 Fields; any valid tax setup
Expected Outcome: Header Tax Amount is disabled/read-only; user cannot manually overwrite the value.

Title: To verify Header Tax Amount equals sum of individual assigned taxes
Steps:
1. Create invoice with multiple lines/tax assignments producing individual taxes 10.00, 15.00, and 5.00.
2. Observe Header Tax Amount.
Expected Outcome: Header Tax Amount = 30.00 (sum of individual taxes) and remains disabled.

Title: To verify Header Tax Amount equals single line tax when only one tax is assigned
Steps:
1. Select Tax Level with 5%.
2. Enter single line subtotal = 500.00.
3. Observe line tax and Header Tax Amount.
Expected Outcome: Line tax = 25.00 and Header Tax Amount = 25.00.

Title: To verify tax recalculates when subtotal changes
Steps:
1. Select Tax Level 10%; enter subtotal 1000 → tax 100.
2. Change subtotal to 2000.
3. Observe tax and Header Tax Amount.
Expected Outcome: Tax and Header Tax Amount update to 200.00.

Title: To verify tax recalculates when Tax Level percentage changes via different Tax Level ID
Steps:
1. Select Tax Level A at 10% with subtotal 1000 (tax 100).
2. Change to Tax Level B at 5%.
3. Observe tax.
Expected Outcome: Tax updates from 100.00 to 50.00.

Title: To verify tax is 0.00 when Tax Level rate is 0%
Steps:
1. Select Tax Level with 0% rate.
2. Enter subtotal 1000.
3. Observe tax and Header Tax Amount.
Expected Outcome: Tax amount and Header Tax Amount = 0.00.

Title: To verify validation blocks or warns before submit when mandatory Tax Level is blank
Steps:
1. Open Smart AP Create From Scratch with Show fields requiring Tax Level.
2. Leave mandatory Tax Level blank.
3. Enter other required invoice fields.
4. Click Submit.
Test Data: Mandatory Tax Level blank; other required fields filled
Expected Outcome: Submit is blocked or clear validation message is shown; invoice is not submitted with missing Tax Authority Level.

Title: To verify validation blocks submit for invalid Tax Level ID
Steps:
1. Enter or force an invalid Tax Level ID.
2. Enter subtotal and required fields.
3. Click Save/Submit.
Expected Outcome: System shows validation error and does not save/submit with invalid Tax Authority Level.

Title: To verify validation after clearing Tax Level post calculation
Steps:
1. Select valid Tax Level and amount so tax calculates.
2. Clear Tax Level ID.
3. Click Submit.
Expected Outcome: Submit is blocked or validation requires Tax Level; inaccurate tax application is prevented.

Title: To verify Tax Authority GLs use Department for Tax Authority from CAS
Steps:
1. In CAS, set Department for Tax Authority = D1; Save.
2. Create Smart AP invoice with Tax Authority Levels and tax GLs.
3. Submit/process and review accounting/GL distribution for tax lines.
Test Data: Department for Tax Authority = D1; valid tax GLs
Expected Outcome: Tax Authority GL postings are associated with department D1 from CAS.

Title: To verify changing Department for Tax Authority applies to new invoices
Steps:
1. Change CAS Department for Tax Authority from D1 to D2; Save.
2. Create a new Smart AP invoice with tax levels.
3. Review tax GL department association.
Expected Outcome: New invoice tax Authority GLs associate with D2.

Title: To verify Use Tax Department for GL Validation ON allows processing for valid dept-GL
Steps:
1. Set Use Tax Department for GL Validation = ON.
2. Ensure Department for Tax Authority and tax GL form a valid combination.
3. Create and submit Smart AP invoice with tax levels.
Expected Outcome: Validation passes; invoice processes (not held for dept-GL mismatch).

Title: To verify Use Tax Department for GL Validation ON holds or blocks invalid dept-GL
Steps:
1. Set Use Tax Department for GL Validation = ON.
2. Configure invalid department and tax GL combination.
3. Create and submit Smart AP invoice with tax levels.
Expected Outcome: Invoice is held or blocked for further submission; user sees hold/validation related to department & GL combination.

Title: To verify Use Tax Department for GL Validation OFF does not hold solely for invalid dept-GL
Steps:
1. Set Use Tax Department for GL Validation = OFF.
2. Use same invalid dept-GL as TC-23.
3. Create and submit Smart AP invoice with tax.
Expected Outcome: Invoice is not held solely due to Use Tax Department for GL Validation (other validations may still apply).

Title: To verify Tax Level ID can be updated from value A to B and persists after save
Steps:
1. Create invoice; select Tax Level A; Save.
2. Reopen invoice; change Tax Level to B; Save.
3. Reopen and verify Tax Level and recalculated tax.
Test Data: Tax Level A then B; valid amounts
Expected Outcome: Tax Level B and recalculated tax persist after save/reopen.

Title: To verify draft/save persists Tax Level IDs and calculated Header Tax Amount
Steps:
1. Set Tax Levels and line amounts so tax calculates.
2. Click Save (draft/save without final submit if available).
3. Reopen the invoice.
Test Data: Show 4 Fields; Tax % and amounts known
Expected Outcome: Saved Tax Level IDs and Header Tax Amount (sum of individual taxes) persist on reopen.

Title: To verify cancel discards unsaved Tax Level changes
Steps:
1. Open existing or new invoice; note current Tax Level.
2. Change Tax Level / amounts without saving.
3. Click Cancel.
4. Reopen or return to prior state.
Expected Outcome: Unsaved Tax Authority Level changes are discarded; prior saved values remain.

Title: To verify Tax Level lookup populates selected ID and is easy to update
Steps:
1. On Smart AP create screen, open Tax Level 1 search/lookup.
2. Search and select a valid ID.
3. Confirm field shows selected ID and can be changed again via lookup.
Expected Outcome: Selected Tax Level ID populates the field; user can update it again via lookup.

Title: To verify end-to-end submit with Tax Authority Levels, correct tax calc, and valid GL validation
Steps:
1. CAS: Tax Type = Tax Authority Levels; Show 4 Fields; Department for Tax Authority = D1; Use Tax Department for GL Validation = ON with valid dept-GL.
2. Param 932 ON if required.
3. Create Smart AP invoice; set Tax Levels; enter subtotal 1000 with 10% tax.
4. Confirm Header Tax = 100 and disabled.
5. Submit.
Expected Outcome: Invoice submits successfully; tax = 100.00; Header Tax disabled and = 100.00; no invalid dept-GL hold.

Title: To verify company switch applies active company CAS Show Tax Level Fields on Smart AP
Steps:
1. Company A: Show 4 Fields.
2. Company B: Show Tax Level Fields = Off (or different count).
3. Switch company in UI and open Smart AP Create From Scratch for each.
Expected Outcome: Smart AP Tax Level visibility matches the active company's CAS Show Tax Level Fields setting.

Title: To verify editing existing tax-authority invoice recalculates tax on amount change
Steps:
1. Open an existing Smart AP invoice that already has Tax Authority Levels and tax.
2. Change line/subtotal amount.
3. Save.
4. Observe tax and Header Tax Amount.
Expected Outcome: Tax and disabled Header Tax Amount recalculate to match new subtotal x tax % and sum of individual taxes.

Title: To verify Header Tax Amount remains disabled when editing an existing invoice
Steps:
1. Open existing tax-authority Smart AP invoice.
2. Attempt to edit Header Tax Amount.
Expected Outcome: Header Tax Amount remains disabled/read-only on edit.
